name: chat_history_search
description: Search past conversation history by date range and summarize what was discussed — e.g. 'what were we talking about last month' or 'what did we discuss last Saturday'. Compute the actual start_date/end_date yourself from the current date you already have; this skill does not parse relative time phrases itself.

action.description: search_by_date: find and summarize messages within a date range.

start_date.description: Start of the range, as 'YYYY-MM-DD' or a full ISO datetime. Compute this yourself from the current date — never pass a relative phrase like 'last month' literally.

end_date.description: End of the range (inclusive, through end of that day), same format as start_date.
